notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (Total Governmental column on p6, fund columns p5-6). Taxes 18,778,746 split using the General Fund breakdown on p14; remaining Debt Service and Street fund taxes kept taxes (unlabeled). Transfers net to zero in the total column (General +28,190,463, Debt Service -27,897,181, Street -293,282), so transfers_in/out are null. debt_proceeds = TIF bonds 22,461,809 + refunding bonds 49,505,000; other_financing = premium 478,347 minus escrow deposit 52,850,532. Governmental ending_cash = Total Governmental Funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents (p3); restricted cash 2,211,106 and county treasurer cash 95,951 are separate lines. Balance sheet uses the government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (p1). Business-type: proprietary Total column of Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position (p8); receipts include nonoperating capital facility charges, disbursements include interest expense; the error correction in Water/Sewer nets to zero in total. proprietary noncapital financing has no section (null). Detail: General Fund recorded from the detailed revenue/expenditure schedules (pp14-15), not the budget schedule on p10 (budgetary basis; double counting avoided; p10 budget figures not carried). Other funds' budget-and-actual schedules (pp11-12, 16) are budgetary basis so actuals differ slightly from the GAAP statement (e.g. Debt Service taxes 2,653,144 vs 2,658,503). Incentive and TIF expenditure rows on p12 are read by position against the row labels on p11 (General government). Debt service fund p16 other financing (46,866,242 proceeds, 2,638,758 transfers in) differs from the p5-6 statement (49,505,000 refunding proceeds, net transfers -27,897,181); recorded as printed. Enterprise Water/Sewer schedule p17 recorded by fund. Read pages 1-17 of 17
